httpx · PyPI

pypi.org/project/httpx/
HTTPX - A next-generation HTTP client for Python. HTTPX is a fully featured HTTP client library for Python 3. It includes an integrated command line client, has support for both HTTP/1.1 and HTTP/2, and provides both sync and async APIs.

QuickStart - HTTPX

Learn how to use HTTPX, a fast and easy-to-use HTTP client library for Python. See examples of how to make requests, handle responses, encode data, and more.
